description.narrative: This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the Lebanon Emergency Response Plan for 2022, which calls for 215 million USD to reach 1.1 million people with humanitarian assistance.

This allocation of 30 million DKK to the UN Country-Based Pooled Fund for Lebanon contributes to meeting the objectives of the Lebanon Emergency Response Plan for 2022, which points to 215 million USD to reach 1.1 million people with humanitarian assistance. The Emergency Response Plan aims at reaching the 1.1 million people most in need. It is the objective of the plan to reach 490,300 people with food security and agricultural assistance; 398,169 people with nutrition assistance; 90,000 people with health assistance and 1 million people with water, sanitation and hygiene assistance.
This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of the Lebanon Emergency Response Plan for 2022, which calls for 215 million USD to reach 1.1 million people with humanitarian assistance.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
